intro: Yeh'kinya in Tanaris tells of an ancient egg named in the Prophecy of Mosh'aru, left from the age when trolls held vast empires. It can contain Hakkar's essence, and Yeh'kinya wants it fetched from Jintha'Alor in the Hinterlands.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The Prophecy of Mosh'aru speaks of an ancient egg. It is a relic of a time when trolls ruled vast empires, and it has the power to hold the essence of Hakkar. It may be the only way to keep our world safe from his evil.
Bring me the ancient egg, friend. It is said to lay hidden deep within Jintha'Alor in the Hinterlands, in a cave behind the amphitheater at the top of the city.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Do you have the ancient egg? I sense great forces stirring, and I fear that time grows short.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Ah, you have the egg! I bow to you, friend. Your strength and bravery will be long remembered.
